config router static6
    edit 1
        set status enable
        set dst ::/0
        set gateway 2001:db8:1::1
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 10
        set weight 0
        set priority 1024
        set comment "IPv6 default route"
        set blackhole disable
        set dynamic-gateway disable
        set dstaddr ''
        set link-monitor-exempt disable
        set bfd disable
        set tag 0
    next
end
